summary_en: MAEDA KOSEN will acquire up to 1.5 million shares (2.25% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of JPY 3.0 billion via ToSTNeT-3 from November 16–30, 2026, to enhance capital efficiency, expand shareholder returns, and secure flexibility for M&A and strategic investments.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, MAEDA KOSEN's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock under the company's articles of incorporation. The company will acquire up to 1.5 million ordinary shares (representing 2.25% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of JPY 3.0 billion via ToSTNeT-3 buy-backs during the period from November 16 through November 30, 2026.

The company stated that the acquired treasury shares will be held for potential use as consideration in future M&A transactions, as employee incentives, and for flexible capital allocation. The acquisition is intended to enhance capital efficiency, expand shareholder returns, and provide financial flexibility for growth investments, alliances, and strategic transactions.

A conflict of interest was identified and managed by excluding from the board vote two related parties: Representative Director and President Naohiro Maeda (the principal shareholder who intends to sell some of his holdings) and Representative Director and Chairman Masatoshi Maeda (a family member). The company noted that depending on the results of this acquisition, the principal shareholder composition may change, and it will promptly disclose any such changes.
